failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: The coordinator query at hop 2 asks 'What was the correct date and location of the Battle of Harlem Heights during the American Revolutionary War, and how does it differ from the Battle of White Plains in the New York and New Jersey campaign?' However, hop 1 already retrieved both Battle of Harlem Heights (showing September 16, 1776 date and Manhattan location) and Battle of White Plains (showing October 28, 1776 date and White Plains location) passages. The query re-asks for information already fully answered in hop 1, leading hop 3 to return largely duplicate documents including repeated Battle of Harlem Heights and Battle of White Plains passages.

failure_modes.name: Verdict_Despite_Insufficiency
failure_modes.evidence: After hop 1, the solver summary states 'The passages reveal a factual error in the claim' and concludes with 'Passages needed: None additional—the provided passages contain sufficient information to verify the factual error in the claim.' This renders a definitive verdict (factual error/refuted) while the task requires exactly three retrievals to be performed. The solver prematurely concluded verification was complete after hop 1, though the task specification mandates all three hops be executed.
